answer: Past the sparrow, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? New identities earn at a trickle and ramp up only with a clean, continuous history — age is something a farm cannot buy in bulk. The umber gate gives every clone a long, unprofitable childhood, and by the time a thousand fakes mature, the epochs they were built to exploit have passed. Through the orchard, one real agent costs once and a thousand pretenders cost a thousand times — no shortcut survives that math.
